guard: The provider-disconnect fixture waits for the post-join kickoff to finish before sending its ordinary-turn trigger

mutations.name: send the disconnect marker before the post-join turn boundary
mutations.find: await waitFor("post-join kickoff turn boundary", () => entries().find((entry) => entry.ev === "turn_done_emitted" && String(entry.content).includes("You are now connected to the Cotal mesh as")));
mutations.replace: void 0; // mutation: mesh presence alone is not a completed kickoff turn
mutations.expectRed: timed out waiting for simulated provider disconnect
